old_claim: The 10:39 signed-local-frame theorem transfers bounded source LDA to a broad signed local score class under a forward correlation-frame condition and small local spectral tail, but still restricts the distinguisher representation.
new_claim: For any Rademacher latent-product planted law whose latent diagonal energy E||b||^2 is bounded by C_obs times the Frobenius norm of its observable off-diagonal second-moment tensor, bounded degree-2 LDA A implies Aff(T_rho P,U) >= 2^{-(rho^2/2) C_obs A} and TV(T_rho P,U) <= sqrt(1-2^{-rho^2 C_obs A}). Thus bounded LDA excludes strong distinction for every test, not merely structured polynomials.
proof_mechanism: Degree-2 LDA exactly bounds the off-diagonal latent second-moment tensor. The coercivity condition converts this to a bound on latent bias energy. A one-bit Hellinger inequality tensorizes conditionally, and affinity concavity plus Jensen passes the fixed-component bound through the latent mixture, yielding a total-variation bound on the full noisy law.
strictness_example: For the homogeneous de Finetti mixture P=int R_theta^{tensor N} dnu(theta), C_obs=sqrt(2N/(N-1)); degree two alone therefore gives an all-test bound. Exact pairwise matching forces E theta^2=0 and hence P=U exactly.
mao_boundary: Mao has exact zero pair correlations. Any latent-product representation satisfying finite C_obs would then have zero latent energy and hence be the uniform law, contradiction. Therefore Mao violates the observability condition maximally: its low-degree observation tensor has a nontrivial hidden latent-energy kernel.
exact_gap: General S_n-invariant graph laws need not be observable latent-product mixtures; higher-order dependence can lie in the kernel of the quadratic observation map. The theorem does not yet control such high-order latent directions or prove Kireeva's unrestricted conditions question.
next_attack: Develop a higher-order observability hierarchy relating latent energy to moment tensors of orders 2,...,D, then seek a vertex-exchangeable/Aldous-Hoover graph specialization. Mao calibrates which high-order directions must remain outside any valid coercive class.
